items.title: Artist's Device Slows Down Citi Bikes in Less Affordable Neighborhoods
items.summary: Justin Blinder's latest project examines New York City’s affordability crisis and makes the disparities felt on a physical level.

items.title: Famed “Portrait of Omai” Will Go on View at LA’s Getty Museum
items.summary: The Sir Joshua Reynolds painting, acquired in a joint deal by the Getty and the National Portrait Gallery in London after a heated controversy, will be on display starting September 14.

items.title: US State Department Takes Down “Woke” Kehinde Wiley Painting
items.summary: “Young Artists After Siamesa 1960” (2015) was removed from the US Embassy in the Dominican Republic and could be sold.
